candidate.name: FINITE-CNF-UNIT-FIXPOINT
candidate.input: Canonical finite sorted CNF, signed nonzero exact integer literals in each clause; clauses sorted unique without both signs of a variable. Empty clause is permitted as explicit immediate contradiction. Assumptions sorted consistent unique literals.
candidate.output: CONTRADICTION if any clause is falsified during unit propagation, else QUIESCENT with exact sorted forced literals (including assumptions), and all_satisfied flag; QUIESCENT does NOT assert that an undecided CNF has a satisfying assignment.
candidate.law: Iterate every currently unit clause to least fixed point, adding only logically forced truth assignments; never branch on undecided atoms. Terminate after finitely many new assignments or a falsified clause.
falsifiers: Contradictory unit clauses are not reported
Unit propagation stops before transitive implications
Unit-free but globally UNSAT CNF wrongly receives SAT verdict
A D10 operator claims D2 branch or physical FPGA opcode authority

owner_connections: Advice Taker and McCarthy symbolic reasoning
caveats: Research reference only, not admitted SENS binary code
No full DPLL SAT solver or D2 control
Quiescence is not proof of satisfiability
A generic logical fixed point may be derivable library law
